about: Delta long-form L1 (16:9, 1920x1080): GTA 5 vs GTA 6, every trailer side by side. Six chapters, each with a title card: the first trailers (GTA V Trailer, Nov 2 2011 vs GTA VI Trailer 1, Dec 2023), three heroes vs two (GTA V Gameplay Video 2013 + Official Trailer vs GTA VI Trailer 2, May 2025, and An Extended Look), the map (Los Santos and Blaine County vs the state of Leonida), the gameplay reveal (GTA V Gameplay Video, July 2013, under 5 min vs An Extended Look, Aug 27 2026, 26:48), the last trailer and the slipped dates, launch day (Take-Two: GTA V more than $800M day one; GTA VI $3.79B day one, 32.5M units pre-release). Official Rockstar clips only, each under 5 s, our graphics between them. Facts and sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.text: GTA 5 vs GTA 6.
lines.say: GTA 5 versus GTA 6.

lines.text: Every trailer, side by side.
Two launches, thirteen years apart.
Both games were late for their first release date.
So did Rockstar run the same playbook twice?
Six chapters. Let's line them up.
Chapter one. The first trailer.
November 2011. The first GTA 5 trailer drops.
lines.say: November twenty eleven. The first GTA 5 trailer drops.

lines.text: December 2023. GTA 6 Trailer 1 lands.
lines.say: December twenty twenty-three. GTA 6 Trailer 1 lands.

lines.text: Twelve years apart. Same first four beats, same order.
Sunset. Beach. Rockstar Games Presents.
Then someone tearing across the water.
Both trailers also leave the city for the wild.
Hikers on a mountain in 2011.
lines.say: Hikers on a mountain in twenty eleven.

lines.text: Flamingos in a swamp in 2023.
lines.say: Flamingos in a swamp in twenty twenty-three.

lines.text: Both stop on one face, looking out at the view.
Michael above Los Santos. Lucia at a window.
But one thing doesn't match at all.
GTA 6 Trailer 1 got over 93 million YouTube views.
lines.say: GTA 6 Trailer 1 got over ninety-three million YouTube views.

lines.text: In its first 24 hours.
lines.say: In its first twenty-four hours.

lines.text: YouTube called it a record for a non-music debut.
Chapter two. Three heroes, then two.
GTA 5 split its story three ways.
Michael. Franklin. Trevor.
The gameplay video showed you jumping between them.
The camera pulls up into the sky.
Then it drops into someone else's life.
GTA 6 tells one story, about two people.
Jason and Lucia.
Trailer 2, in May 2025, shows Jason first.
lines.say: Trailer 2, in May twenty twenty-five, shows Jason first.

lines.text: Then Lucia, outside a prison fence.
Three stories in GTA 5. One shared story in GTA 6.
In Rockstar's words, they have to rely on each other.
Chapter three. The map.
GTA 5 gave you Los Santos and Blaine County.
One city, its hills, and a desert behind it.
GTA 6 goes for a whole state.
Rockstar calls it Leonida.
Its big city is back: Vice City, USA.
lines.say: Its big city is back: Vice City, U S A.

lines.text: Now watch the same kind of shot in both.
A speedboat under a bridge in Los Santos.
Two people on a jet ski in Leonida.
And the skyline as the sun goes down.
Los Santos at dusk. Leonida with helicopters overhead.
Chapter four. The gameplay reveal.
July 2013. GTA 5 shows its first gameplay video.
lines.say: July twenty thirteen. GTA 5 shows its first gameplay video.

lines.text: It runs just under five minutes.
August 2026. GTA 6 answers with An Extended Look.
lines.say: August twenty twenty-six. GTA 6 answers with An Extended Look.

lines.text: 26 minutes and 48 seconds.
lines.say: Twenty-six minutes and forty-eight seconds.

lines.text: That's more than five times as long.
And the beats line up again.
Get in a car, check the minimap, drive.
Then put on a mask and rob a store.
Rockstar says An Extended Look is in-game footage.
All of it, captured on a PlayStation 5.
Chapter five. The last trailer.
2013. The GTA 5 Official Trailer. One minute long.
lines.say: Twenty thirteen. The GTA 5 Official Trailer. One minute long.

lines.text: October 2026. The GTA 6 Launch Trailer. About a minute and a half.
lines.say: October twenty twenty-six. The GTA 6 Launch Trailer. About a minute and a half.

lines.text: Both end on a date.
And both games missed their first one.
GTA 5 was due in spring 2013.
lines.say: GTA 5 was due in spring twenty thirteen.

lines.text: It slipped to September 17.
lines.say: It slipped to September seventeenth.

lines.text: GTA 6 Trailer 1 ended on 2025.
lines.say: GTA 6 Trailer 1 ended on twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Trailer 2 ended on May 26, 2026.
lines.say: Trailer 2 ended on May twenty-sixth, twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: GTA 6 came out November 19, 2026.
lines.say: GTA 6 came out November nineteenth, twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: First trailer to launch, GTA 5 took about 22 months.
lines.say: First trailer to launch, GTA 5 took about twenty-two months.

lines.text: GTA 6 took almost three years.
Chapter six. Launch day.
September 17, 2013. GTA 5 launches.
lines.say: September seventeenth, twenty thirteen. GTA 5 launches.

lines.text: Day one: more than $800 million.
lines.say: Day one: more than eight hundred million dollars.

lines.text: Thirteen years later, GTA 6 launches.
Day one: $3.79 billion.
lines.say: Day one: three point seven nine billion dollars.

lines.text: That's more than four times the GTA 5 number.
Plus 32.5 million copies sold before it even came out.
lines.say: Plus thirty-two point five million copies sold before it even came out.

lines.text: So, same playbook?
Same opening beats. Same late launch. Yes.
Same playbook. A very different scoreboard.
Now you pick. Which first trailer wins?
2011, or 2023? Tell me in the comments.
lines.say: Twenty eleven, or twenty twenty-three? Tell me in the comments.
